scenes.title: Phone back and the signed PDF

lines.text: Security has filled in the FOCA Checklist and hands you the phone.
This guide is for Airline Representatives of foreign air carriers.
Here is what changed.
Before, this was a printed paper form, signed with a pen.
Now it is the same form, on the Security officer’s phone.
You sign with your finger, and the signed PDF is saved automatically, in a restricted AirAsia folder.
Every form works in four steps.
Security fills the form, and hands you the phone.
You check, type your name and ID, and sign.
Then the phone goes back, and Security signs and saves.
Blue is Security.
Orange is you.
You need nothing to install, and no account.
Security brings the phone.
Have your own name and ID or staff number ready.
Read the form before you sign, and if it is wrong, say so.
Sign only for yourself.
This part is for the Airline Representative of a foreign carrier.
This is the paper form we used.
Security fills pages one and two.
On page two, the Security Rep signs, and the Airline Representative signs.
The app shows the same form, so your job is the same: check the checklist and sign it.
In the app, Security fills the form, then hands you the phone.
Tap the orange button to show that you have the phone.
Read the flight details.
Then check each line that Security has ticked.
If anything is wrong, tap ‘Something is wrong’.
The phone goes back to Security.
If everything is correct, type your own name and ID or staff number.
Sign in the box with your finger.
Not happy with the signature?
Tap ‘Clear’ and sign again.
Then tap ‘Confirm my signature’.
When the screen says so, give the phone back to Security.
Security signs and saves the record.
Security saves, and the app creates the signed PDF.
This is a real signed PDF from a TEST record.
Security staff email the PDF to you.
Keep it for your records.
Remember: check your name and role on screen, and read the details before signing.
Type your own name and ID if asked.
Sign with your finger, then Confirm, and hand the phone back to Security.
Don’t sign for someone else, or if the details are wrong.
Don’t close the app, press Back, or take photos of the screen.
Your signature goes into one signed PDF per form, with every signature and a Record ID.
It is saved to a restricted AirAsia folder, with a record log.
A PDF copy of the signed FOCA Checklist is shared with you by email.
Have a question?
Ask the Security staff on duty.
